_provenance: Anonymized snapshot of a real 30-device deployment (July 2026). Device IDs, names, manufacturers and models are genericized: a protocol fixture must not carry one operator's room names, brands or hardware. What IS preserved is what makes this fixture worth having and no synthetic corpus reproduces — the structure of an installation nobody designed to look good: inconsistent tags, bridged entities nobody curated, housekeeping sensors left registered. Tags and capabilities are byte-identical to the original; only identifiers changed, verified by running the benchmark against both and comparing every metric.
